title: Open lab classroom with central round tables, wall monitors and bench workstations

At least three desktop computer monitors are visible on the right-side bench line (one is turned to show a camera image, two appear to be turned off or showing dark screens).
There are multiple bench workstations along the right wall with under-bench drawers/cabinets; at least five separate bench segments are visible along that wall.
Three circular/rounded group tables are visible in the center area, each composed of multiple wedge-shaped segments.
At least eleven office/task chairs with five-star wheeled bases are visible around the central tables and along the benches (chairs are partially overlapping and some are obscured).
Several pieces of bench-top equipment or instruments are visible on the right bench (multiple rectangular boxes with displays or controls), but model names or types are not legible from the image.
A red vertical storage rack or cabinet with multiple hanging items is visible back-right near the wall; a tall blue rack or shelving unit with small drawers is visible further toward the back center.
Multiple printed posters are mounted along the right wall above the bench workstations (many distinct posters in a row).
A small freestanding lectern or equipment stand is visible near the far-left wall below the left wall-mounted screen.
